subject: Re: VPC / Dedicated deployment for FinPay — next steps?
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liao <sarah.liao@finpay.com>; Alex Moreno <amoreno@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps — FinPay / Redwood discovery

Hi Sarah / Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- What we heard: low-latency inference for customer-facing workflows, sensitive PII in logs, and an enterprise requirement for data separation (likely VPC/private deployment).
- Suggested path: 1) Tech deep-dive with your infra/security team to walk network/KMS needs; 2) Pricing/terms conversation (Dedicated capacity vs Private); 3) Procurement & SOC2 evidence exchange.

Next steps I propose:
- Tech deep-dive (30–45 min) w/ your infra folks — are you available next Tue/Wed afternoon PT?
- I’ve attached the call notes (discovery-notes.pdf). Marissa will follow up with a draft SOW and a VPC/network diagram if you want to evaluate Private/Dedicated options.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf

From: Sarah Liao <sarah.liao@finpay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — FinPay / Redwood discovery

Thanks Jonas — helpful recap. We're interested in the Private/VPC option given our compliance needs. A few asks from our side before we schedule the tech deep-dive: 

- Can you share network requirements (CIDR ranges, peering/Transit requirements) and expected egress behaviors?
- Ballpark pricing difference between hosted, Dedicated, and Private (monthly committed capacity).
- Our security team has a short questionnaire — attaching (security-questionnaire.pdf). Please have the appropriate folks fill out or point us to the SOC2 / encryption docs.

If possible, please include someone from solutions/implementation on the next call — we have Alex (network) and Priya (security) available next Wednesday afternoon PT.

Best,
Sarah
Director, Platform Security | FinPay
sarah.liao@finpay.com

Attachments: security-questionnaire.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liao <sarah.liao@finpay.com>; Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — FinPay / Redwood discovery

Hi Sarah — looping in the implementation/solutions side here. Quick answers and what we can provide ahead of the call: 

- Network: we can support VPC peering or private connectivity via AWS Transit/Direct Connect. Typical requirements: allow outbound to our control-plane IPs (we’ll provide a narrow list), establish a peering/route for inference nodes, and optional private endpoints for telemetry. I’ve attached a network diagram for a Private deployment (network_diagram.png).
- Pricing: hosting < Dedicated < Private in terms of base cost; exact delta depends on committed GPU capacity and retention of private control-plane. I’m attaching a draft SOW for an initial Dedicated/Private engagement (finpay_sow_v1.pdf) to give ballpark figures.
- Compliance artifacts: we can provide SOC2 report and encryption/HSM integration notes before procurement.

Proposed next steps:
1) Tech deep-dive Wed 6 Aug 2026 1:00–1:45 PM PT (Jonas, Marissa, Alex from FinPay, Priya from FinPay) — confirm?
2) We’ll fill the security questionnaire and post answers into the shared Doc.
3) If tech review looks good, we’ll scope a pilot Dedicated pool (30–60 days) while we finalize Private deployment terms.

Let me know if the time works.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: finpay_sow_v1.pdf, network_diagram.png

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liao <sarah.liao@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in — VPC timeline?

Hi Sarah — quick bump following Marissa's note. Wanted to check whether the Private/VPC option is still a priority on your side for Q3 budgeting. If so, we can lock the tech deep-dive and have the security questionnaire responses ready before the call to accelerate procurement.

Availability windows I have next week: Mon 8/9 10–12 PT, Wed 8/11 1–3 PT. If those don't work, share a couple of times or feel free to pick on my calendar: https://cal.example.com/jonas-weber

No rush — just checking timing so we can prioritize resources (we've reserved a solutions engineer slot for your pilot if you want it).

Best,
Jonas

(If you'd like, we can also start with a short pilot on Dedicated to de-risk before committing to Private.)
